title: Before your first answer counts
intro: Browsing is open to everyone. Before any answer of yours is counted, we ask once, here.
draft: Draft. These words have not yet been reviewed by a lawyer and may change before BeliefAtlas opens to the public.
held: Your answer, {choice}, is waiting. It counts as soon as you agree.
heldPrivate: It will count as a private answer.

points.kept: We keep your answers and when and where you gave them, and use them for the results and your belief map.
points.private: Any answer can be private: it counts in the totals but is never shown with your name.
points.sale: Selling data is a separate choice. It is off unless you turn it on, and you never need it to answer.

saleCheckbox: Also include my answers, without my name, in data that is sold. I can turn this off at any time in Settings.
saleGpc: Your browser sent a Global Privacy Control signal, so your answers are never included in data that is sold.
saleClosed: Data sales aren't offered where you are, so nothing about you is sold.
notNowNote: Without agreeing you can still browse every question. A held answer waits for 24 hours.
settingsNote: You can see and change these choices at any time in <link>Settings</link>.

errors.textChanged: The wording changed while you were reading. Please read it again.
errors.missingText: The agreement text isn't available right now. Try again in a minute.
